The presence of a direct interaction between S-Hexylglutathione and Glutathione peroxidase, along with the indirect pathway through Glutathione sulfonic acid, indicates a possible mechanism where S-Hexylglutathione may modulate the activity of Glutathione peroxidase. This could involve competitive inhibition or allosteric regulation, which are common mechanisms in enzyme interactions. The evidence is supported by a high confidence score, suggesting a plausible biological relationship.
